purpose: Evidence pack for the first bounded manual review batch. These are proposed relevance decisions only and do not alter the terminal IGOD assessment state or authorize publication.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Schemes and Services: PMEGP, CGTMSE, Procurement and Marketing Support, Consortia and Tender Marketing, MSME Champions, and Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programs
rows.rationale: The ministry publishes business-facing finance, market-access, technology, formalisation, and entrepreneurship offerings for MSMEs and self-employed applicants.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Central Government Schemes section: initiatives by Central Ministries and Departments supporting startups through financial, infrastructural, and regulatory support
rows.rationale: The ministry family includes DPIIT and Startup India, which publish startup recognition, funding, procurement, mentorship, and ecosystem routes.

rows.evidenceAnchor: SPICe+ Part A and Part B with linked services, including incorporation and PAN/TAN allocation
rows.rationale: MCA controls a core company-incorporation and continuing-compliance journey required by the Start and Operate pillar.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0): eligibility and list of TIDE centres
rows.rationale: MeitY publishes technology-incubation, startup, testing, certification, and production-support routes relevant to technology businesses and incubators.

rows.evidenceAnchor: PMFME guideline sections covering individual units, groups, common infrastructure, credit-linked subsidy, and State/UT implementation
rows.rationale: MoFPI publishes formalisation, subsidy, common-infrastructure, and food-processing project routes for businesses and producer groups.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
rows.evidenceAnchor: PMKVY 4.0 candidate, training-provider, Recognition of Prior Learning, and Skill India implementation routes
rows.rationale: MSDE controls training, apprenticeship, provider, and entrepreneurship-support routes that affect founders, workers, and growing businesses.

rows.authorityName: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
rows.evidenceAnchor: DPIIT recognition, self-certification, intellectual-property support, tax-exemption route, and public-procurement benefits
rows.rationale: DPIIT directly administers startup recognition and multiple startup ecosystem and market-access programmes.

rows.evidenceAnchor: PMMY categories and Member Lending Institutions route
rows.rationale: DFS publishes and coordinates formal credit routes used by micro businesses and self-employed applicants, including lender-mediated products that must be kept separate from grants.
